sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and hero stage list
sections.what: Brings in the stage list, the plant picture and the type for inline styles, then builds a hero-only list with the controls stage removed.
sections.why: Likely reason: the controls stage is not part of the story the hero tells.
sections.watch_out: The removal matches a fixed stage id, so renaming that id would make the controls stage reappear.

sections.name: PlantHero
sections.title: Hero layout and caption
sections.what: Builds the figure: the plant picture, an ordered list of stages with colour and position values, and a caption stating the picture is illustrative.
sections.why: Likely reason: the caption tells visitors the picture is not built from their data.
sections.watch_out: Timing uses the list position, so reordering the stages changes the playback order.

summary: The hero block on the landing page: the decorative plant picture, a row of five lifecycle stage names that light up in turn, and a caption saying the picture is illustrative.
purpose: Introduces the app visually while making clear the picture is not the visitor's own data.
why: Reason not stated in the code. The caption shows the intent: visitors should not mistake the picture for their own model.
how: Takes the lifecycle stage list, removes the controls stage, and renders the plant picture followed by an ordered list of the remaining stages. Each stage gets its colour and its position as a value for timing. The actual timing is set in the stylesheet.
inputs: The lifecycle stage list from the workspace module.
outputs: A figure element containing the plant canvas, a stage list and a caption.
risks: The stylesheet assumes five stages in five columns. Adding or removing stages changes the layout and the timing.
debug: If stages do not light up, check the stage animation rules in the landing stylesheet. If a stage is missing, check the filter that removes the controls stage.
